biography.value:
Description

This fierce creature has a vaguely humanoid head of determination, the body of a proud lion, and the wings of a red dragon. Its tail ends in long, sharp spikes.

Defense

AC 21, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+4 Dex, +8 natural, -1 size)

hp 112 (10d10+60)

Fort +13, Ref +11, Will +6

Immune Poison & Burn; Resist Wind 10, Fire 10, Earth 5

Offense

Speed 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (clumsy)

Melee bite +16 (1d8+7), 2 claws +16 (2d4+7 plus grab), tail slap +11 (1d8+3)

Ranged 4 spikes +14 (1d6+7)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (30-ft. cone, 5d8 fire damage, Reflex DC 21 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Deadly Hold, Filth Cloud, Sandstorm, Swoop Charge

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 19, Con 22, Int 11, Wis 16, Cha 13

Base Atk +10; CMB +18; CMD 32 (34 vs. grapple, 36 vs. trip)

Feats Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Weapon Focus (spikes)

Skills Fly +3, Perception +16, Stealth +6, Survival +6 (+10 tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Survival when tracking

Languages Common

GM note: CMD 34 vs grapple, 36 vs trip.

description.value: 5/day, a manticore can release a breath weapon to creatures in a 30-ft.-cone.
